# Shield

> Sovereign client-side secret redactor and fail-closed HTTP wire guard proxy for AI coding agents with Shannon entropy scanning.

## Core Capabilities
- Shannon Entropy Scanning: Detects high-entropy keys (>4.2 bits/char) without depending on known regex prefixes.
- Deterministic Tokenization: Swaps detected secrets with fixed-width synthetic placeholders (`[SECRET_REF_...]`) before outbound network transit.
- Fail-Closed Wire Guard: Inspects outbound transport buffers and aborts with HTTP 502 if unmasked secrets are present on the wire.
- Invisible Unicode Stripping: Removes zero-width non-joiners, zero-width spaces, and hidden tags used in evasion.
- AST Reassembly: Verifies syntax validity before injecting real secrets back into response streams.
- In-Memory Zeroization: Memory-safe scrubbing of active secret maps via `TokenMap.Zeroize()`.

## CLI Usage
- `shield proxy --port 8080`: Launches the local redaction proxy.
- `shield scan --file <path>`: Scans local files for unmasked credentials.
- `shield doctor`: Probes proxy readiness and SSRF firewall rules.

## Key Addresses & Paths
- Loopback Proxy: `http://127.0.0.1:8080`
- Health Endpoint: `http://127.0.0.1:8080/health`
- Documentation: README.md & AGENTS.md
